'''Chortose''' was an astronomical object<ref name="GG6-2" /> located in the [[Chortose system/Legends|Chortose system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chortose (species)/Legends|Chortose]] [[Species/Legends|species]], including the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Porgo Goo]].<ref name="GG6-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chortose was first mentioned in the [[1990]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', which was written by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Chortose [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Chortose itself, in grid square N-20.<ref name="TEA" />
